findings: Four native rasters were inspected: installed inner bearing, cap-only fastener detail, one stud/nut/cotter set and frame with all four fastened bearings.

The catalogue supplies eight MX9, four MX10 and four MX36 physical stud identities and printed lengths, with sixteen nuts and split pins. Bare stud identities differ from nested stud-assembly records.
Full printed stud lengths constrain rear blind bosses and spotfaced cap seats; the eight changed castings retain lining, split and closed-cover/hinge fits.

All sixteen local fastening checks pass, including seats, specified gaps, full US-thread-region receiver wall and positive diagnostic interference. These are geometric checks, not thread/load qualification.

Threads remain cylindrical envelopes. Nut dimensions, cast profiles, split-pin eye/legs and their installed orientation are inferred. Cotter centerline length follows the stated interpretation; original half-round stock and exact material volume are not reproduced.
The handbook shows cast blends, rounded cup corners, oil inlet/fittings and wool still missing from the candidate. Its open lid differs from the standard closed native configuration.
